WITH ss_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1071 THEN AVG(ss_ext_tax) ELSE AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) END AS bucket1,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 39161 THEN AVG(ss_ext_tax) ELSE AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) END AS bucket2,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 29434 THEN AVG(ss_ext_tax) ELSE AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) END AS bucket3,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 6568 THEN AVG(ss_ext_tax) ELSE AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) END AS bucket4,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 21216 THEN AVG(ss_ext_tax) ELSE AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) END AS bucket5
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 OR ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100
)
SELECT r_reason_sk, bucket1, bucket2, bucket3, bucket4, bucket5
FROM reason
WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
